up: List the compounds reported in document CHEMBL1909046. Return the compound ChEMBL ID, preferred name, and compound key.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, md.pref_name AS pref_name, cr.compound_key AS compound_key FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1909046'
